_comment: Copy to ~/.config/omadjinn/config.json. Read every time a script runs; no reload needed. All optional features are off by default. dragRestore: dragging a snapped window out with SUPER + LEFT MOUSE resizes it to the default floating size. snapTiled: snap also floats tiled and scrolling windows. swap: snapping into a taken zone swaps with the window there. rightClickMenu: right-click a floating window's titlebar for the zone menu. keys: your own key for an action (snapLeft, snapRight, snapUp, snapDown, stackLeft, stackRight, stackUp, stackDown, stackNext, stackPrev, layoutPrev, layoutNext, menu, settings); an empty string switches that key off.
